what_this_is: Which measurement decides which court. Declared as data so the docket carries it and the judge holds no per-court branches. A court with no binding stays NOT JUDGED - that is the honest default, not an edge case.

rules.PASS: every bound test ran and passed, and at least one matched
rules.FAIL: any bound test failed or errored
rules.NOT JUDGED: no binding declared, or no bound test matched the report

SPEC-11.1.why: Uniform Cell: no second persisted semantic shape or side authority.

SPEC-11.2.why: Authority coherence: no active contradiction; mutable facts are generated.

SPEC-11.3.why: No hidden interpreter: graph path and any fast path are equivalent.

SPEC-11.4.why: One identity: every lens resolves the same roots and facts.

SPEC-11.5.why: Explicit causality: rewiring authority changes behavior; deleting projection does not.

SPEC-11.6.why: Persistent attention: signals, reasons, focus, obligations and cursors recover after restart.

SPEC-11.7.why: Replay: graph state reconstructs deterministically and effects do not repeat.

SPEC-11.8.why: Attention security: hidden roots cannot influence visible output or context.

SPEC-11.10.why: Real interfaces: sockets, cables, relations, incidences and n-ary cases are exact.

SPEC-11.11.why: Properties: panels/editors are graph-projected and no tab is dead.

SPEC-11.15.why: Lifecycle/effect: independent states, receipts, reconciliation, conflicts, recovery and compensation are proven.

SPEC-11.16.why: Core Values: each value maps to a passing control or visible gap.
